reviewType: Independent AI editorial read and purposive primary-source sample; not human mechanic certification
result: Completed with one minor precision finding corrected during integration; no unresolved manuscript correction identified within stated coverage.

coverage.bodyReadMethod: All 100 substantive bodies were read for unsupported repair/model/cost claims, misleading thresholds, unresolved mappings and generic filler. The identical source/applicability paragraph was verified across all 100. Twenty selected bodies were additionally compared to their actual primary-source rows and continuation pages.
coverage.sampleSelection: Purposive coverage of checked and needs-review cases across cam timing, oxygen heaters/sensors, intake/oil temperature, throttle/boost, injectors, knock, coils, fan control, cold-start ignition, internal pedal/ASIC supervision and transmission speed/pressure. Numeric units, row boundaries and internal-to-generic mapping risks were prioritized.
coverage.sourcePageNumbering: One-based physical PDF pages, not internal ECM/TCM section numbers

primarySource.visualNote: Original PDF rendered for layout, inequalities, units and mapping ambiguity; page 701 had also been directly inspected during the earlier batch-15 source work and was reread as source text during this review.

findings.issue: Original wording described an absolute-difference branch as having a negative boundary. The PDF prints <0(%): zero is the boundary and the criterion would require a negative result.
findings.recommendedCorrection: One branch requires an absolute difference below zero, which is not adopted as a usable service threshold here.
findings.correctionVerification: Reread corrected paragraph and original PDF page 621; current file SHA256 is recorded in sample and body inventory.

similarityScreen.scope: Only the 100 batch-11 articles, not other batches or the internet.
similarityScreen.method: Exact full Markdown body comparison and pairwise five-token shingle Jaccard on lowercased substantive text; metadata, Markdown headings and shared source/applicability section excluded from shingle comparison.
similarityScreen.editorialAssessment: No title-only-swapped filler identified in the all-body read. Shared cylinder/gear/channel monitor families explicitly disclose shared logic while distinguishing the targeted channel and diagnostic interpretation. Low lexical similarity is a supporting screen, not proof of usefulness or source accuracy.

metadataChecks.wordCountNote: This deliberately narrow substantive-body measure differs from the project total-word validator; it is not a replacement for its 27,527-word batch total.

Closed-loop eligibility and two-trip reporting are preserved; motion alone is not treated as proof of timely response.
samples.assessment: No correction identified.

checkedClaims: Bank 2 intake-cam offset limits are above 12.59 or below -8.79 crankshaft degrees, not symmetric universal timing specifications.
Four crankshaft revolutions of valid signals/synchronization qualify a two-cam-revolution comparison; one-trip reporting is separate.
samples.assessment: No correction identified.

samples.assessment: Existing needs-review mapping flag is justified. No new correction.

checkedClaims: Physical temperature above 122.76 degrees C and electrical signal above 4800 mV are distinct documented paths.
Both paths use two seconds and two trips; internal sensor 4 nomenclature is not silently equated to a pin or component location.
samples.assessment: No correction identified.

checkedClaims: Absolute raw-versus-filtered temperature difference above 10 K for 20 seconds matches the gradient-check row.
After-filter bank 2 strategy and filtered sensor 1 wording leave the data-channel mapping unresolved; the article does not invent a wiring cause.
samples.assessment: Existing needs-review channel flag is justified. No new correction.

checkedClaims: Bank 2 sensor 2 loading comparison uses three load pulses with prior fault suspicion and readiness.

samples.assessment: No correction identified; font-encoded loading-path values were visually inspected and are not promoted into an external test.

checkedClaims: Cold-start reference comparison includes engine-off duration greater than 28800 seconds, valid sensor signal and completed reference calculation.
The paired subtraction rows visibly print greater than 14.96 and less than 14.96 degrees C, respectively; one-second/two-trip information is retained without silently repairing the comparator.
samples.assessment: Existing needs-review comparator flag is justified. No new correction.

checkedClaims: Position-channel difference uses a mapped 5 to 6.25 percent boundary and the charge-model comparison lists 9.0234 percent.
DRIVE/POSTDRIVE and safety/charge qualifications are retained. The anomalous absolute-difference clause actually prints less than zero percent.
samples.assessment: Minor wording correction applied by root and independently reread: negative boundary replaced by absolute difference below zero. Source ambiguity remains needs-review.

checkedClaims: Electrical path is raw voltage below 0.15 V for 1.5 seconds, ignition on, two trips.
Physical-range-low row prints greater than 250 hPa with 400 milliseconds and one trip; article explicitly preserves this comparator issue instead of supplying an assumed threshold.
samples.assessment: Existing needs-review comparator flag is justified. No new correction.

checkedClaims: Cylinder 3 misfire count above 100 is combined with rail-pressure-control minimum-error status.
Eligibility above 1520/below 6000 rpm, relative charge below 100 percent, no electrical injector failure and no statistical inhibit matches the five-second/two-trip monitor.
samples.assessment: No correction identified; shared cylinder-family logic is openly described.

checkedClaims: Internal ADC buffer has beginning/end controlled-valve-operation alternatives; the PDF displays digital counts, not external voltage or resistance.
Twenty events, ignition-on/common eligibility and two-trip reporting match the table. The physical cylinder/connector mapping is expressly not supplied by this row.
samples.assessment: No correction identified; generic catalog mapping is not represented as physical connector evidence.

checkedClaims: Knock sensor 3 open-load integration uses 30 events, two trips and a speed-dependent 15 to 120 second schedule.
PWM duty above 50 percent, rpm above 800/below 5000 and load above 13/below 160 percent qualify the monitor. Internal numerical integration boundary is not treated as an ohmmeter specification.
samples.assessment: No correction identified.

checkedClaims: Bank 1 intake-cam no-edge/low-level logic requires at least four crankshaft revolutions, recognized crank gap and no backward rotation.
One-trip reporting and signal-level-at-transition distinction are preserved; absence of edges is separated from timing correlation.
samples.assessment: No correction identified; PDF visual check confirmed the extraction-obscured greater-than-or-equal sign.

checkedClaims: Low feedback during the driver OFF state is documented open-load evidence, qualified by synchronization, rpm above 1400 and ignition counter difference above nine.
The row calls the coil B while the catalog calls it E; no physical cylinder assignment is asserted. 0.4 second and two trips match; atypical upper supply value is not used as a service limit.
samples.assessment: Existing needs-review mapping/supply flag is justified. Different internal labels do not prove either definition wrong.

checkedClaims: Actual fan 1 speed minus maximum estimated speed is compared to a mapped 1300 to 4050 rpm deviation, not a normal fan-speed range.
Twenty-second assessment, two-trip reporting and qualifying command/supply state are accurately distinguished.
samples.assessment: No correction identified.

checkedClaims: Idle ignition efficiency is compared with catalyst-heating requested efficiency, with heating active and elapsed heating time above ten seconds.
Mapped 0.27 to 0.999 efficiency deviation, two-second assessment, two-trip reporting and end-of-start/homogeneous/initial-fueling context match the source.
samples.assessment: No correction identified; numerical boundary is not presented as an ignition angle.

checkedClaims: Part/full-pedal calculation takes maximum of each signal and 848 mV before comparing absolute difference against 360.6 mV; assessment is 0.026 seconds.
Null-load ADC test must be inactive; separate learned minimum normalized values are checked for each sensor across monitoring levels.
samples.assessment: No correction identified; visual formula check confirmed the prose accurately describes the floor operation.

checkedClaims: Bank 1 and bank 2 SPI information errors from ignition diagnostic power-stage ASICs share P06D1.
Twenty events/one trip, synchronization, rpm above 1400 and counter advance above nine match the source; printed 655340 mV upper supply is not adopted as a practical limit.
samples.assessment: Existing needs-review atypical supply-value flag is justified. No new correction.

checkedClaims: Odd-clutch input high-voltage branch uses above 4230 mV with 30 mV hysteresis; pulse jump greater than 15 microseconds is conditioned by frequency at least 40 Hz.

VSS1 above 8250/below 10000 mV, at least 300 ms confirmation and P0882/P0883 inhibition are preserved. The less-than-144/greater-than-218 microsecond non-direction clause remains explicitly unresolved.
samples.assessment: Existing needs-review pulse-logic flag is justified. No new correction.

checkedClaims: Target-minus-measured system pressure is compared with an attachment-defined limit; 2 bar is hysteresis, not the failure boundary.
1500 ms confirmation, pressure/pilot-valve electrical eligibility and hydraulic pump/recovery/priming conditions match the row.
samples.assessment: No correction identified; attachment calibration is not invented.

limitations: Only 20 of 100 articles received deep primary-row verification; the other 80 received editorial body reading and structural checks, not an exhaustive source audit.
The 2025 GM 07A Part 2 application-matrix filename join remains unresolved. This review verifies no model, engine, transmission fitment or Corvette applicability.
Existing needs-review flags remain open. An accurately disclosed OEM table ambiguity is not resolved by this review.

The review did not validate vehicle-specific service procedures, physical connector locations, repair success, costs, driving safety, every lookup-table attachment or every generic SAE code definition independently.
This is an AI editorial/source sampling review, not a human mechanic inspection, professional certification, exhaustive publication approval or validation of all site content.
No manuscripts, shared manifests, commits or publication settings were changed by this reviewer; root applied the single reported wording correction.
